react_native_issues.issue: React Native's Alert.alert is a no-op in Expo web preview — the 'Select a strategy' / 'Owner login required' / 'Research complete' / 'Backtest failed' alerts are invisible on web. Native iOS/Android will render them correctly. If web parity is desired, consider a react-native-web compatible alert (e.g., toast/snackbar) or a small wrapper that falls back to window.alert on web. Reference: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/research.tsx:121,124,139,140
